_repro.paper: Code LLMs for binary security patch detection (TOSEM 2026)

stages.name: setup
stages.description: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct weights; released test splits; re-score shipped GPT-3.5/DeepSeek-R1 predictions

steps.name: model
steps.cmd: HF_HUB_OFFLINE=0 python -c "from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download as s; print(s('Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct'))"

stages.name: main
stages.description: Table 1 zero-shot: the authors' LLM-online/llm_online.py against a local vLLM (Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct)

steps.name: predict
steps.cmd: W={RESULTS}; mkdir -p $W/run_online/test_data && cp {REPO}/LLM-online/llm_online.py $W/run_online/ && python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('{RESULTS}/data/alpaca_data/{dataset}/test.json')); n='{N}'; d=d[:int(n)] if n else d; json.dump(d, open('$W/run_online/test_data/{dataset}.json','w'))" && cd $W/run_online && python llm_online.py -u $OPENAI_BASE_URL -k local -m Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct -d {dataset} -t 16384 && mkdir -p {RESULTS}/saves && cp -r saves/{dataset} {RESULTS}/saves/
